summary: Package loads and executes remote code from a mutable Bitbucket branch
details: The package's only shipped file, index.html (declared as `main`), fetches https://bitbucket.org/p2p-alt-public/p2p-emis/raw/main/GameWebSight with a Date.now() cache-buster and injects the response into the DOM via document.open/document.write/document.close, executing whatever HTML and scripts the remote returns. The branch reference is `main` — mutable and unpinned — and there is no integrity/hash verification, so the maintainer (or anyone who compromises the Bitbucket repo) can ship arbitrary code to every consumer who loads this file. There are no install-time lifecycle hooks; the harm fires only when a user explicitly opens index.html in a browser, not on `npm install` or on `require()`. Routing to human review: the remote-fetch-and-execute pattern from a mutable third-party host is genuinely unsafe, but execution is gated behind an explicit user action (opening the HTML), so the auto-execute-on-default-install threshold for a public block verdict is not met.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
